## Purpose
Reads and deletes Mistral conversations (Conversations API) for the caller's workspace.

## Responsibilities
| Method and path | Calls |
|---|---|
| `GET /conversations` | `conversation_service.list_conversations` |
| `GET /conversations/{id}` | `get_conversation` |
| `GET /conversations/{id}/history` | `get_conversation_history` |
| `DELETE /conversations/{id}` | `delete_conversation` |

## Key elements
Four thin handlers, each using `Depends(get_mistral_client)`.

## Control flow
None.

## Data, state and side effects
Calls Mistral with the workspace's key.

## Configuration
None.

## Interactions
- Route policy: chat.use or orchestrator.use.
- Used by the chat history views.

## Error handling and edge cases
Service exceptions such as `ConversationNotFoundError` map to 404 through the global handlers.

## Nuances and gotchas
None.

## How to rebuild this file
Four handlers delegating to `services/conversation_service.py`.
